svg.aria-label: A timeline of the 4-hour lab window, counted from the start time: 10 minutes to sign in, launch the lab and check readiness; Exercise 1, grounding the agent, 35 minutes; Exercise 2, ticket and incident intelligence, 25 minutes; Exercise 3, the MCP read tools, 35 minutes; Exercise 4, the MCP action tools, 50 minutes; Exercise 5, identity, secrets and authorization, 30 minutes; Exercise 6, data protection and auditability, 30 minutes; Exercise 7, the end-to-end scenario and business case, 15 minutes; and 10 minutes to close. A marker moves along the timeline and each exercise card lights up in turn. After the window, reviewers judge the submitted work for 24 hours, with no participant work.
svg.title: Your 4-hour lab window at a glance
